title: {name} is not there
help: Its folder is missing: it was moved, renamed or deleted, or it is on a drive that is not connected. Locate it where it is now, and its tab, pin and colour, trust, bookmarks and what you learned of it go with it.
waits: Left as it is, it opens again by itself when its folder is back.
removeHelp: Its tab and recent entry go, with what Haunt kept of it here (bookmarks, pins, what you learned of it). Its folder is not touched. Trust stays in Settings, Trust.
since: Missing since {since}. If it is still missing on {forget}, Haunt forgets it: its tab, recent entry and what it kept of it go (its trust stays in Settings, Trust).
